title: pr-heuristic-journal
content:
Purpose: a lightweight, personal log of review heuristics and small follow-ups I keep on-hand when doing PRs. Not intended for distribution — rough thoughts, quick checklists, and tiny experiments to try next time.

Quick mental model (3 questions):
- Is the change obvious to someone who knows the subsystem? If not, ask for a short summary in the PR description.
- Does it touch hot path/perf (inference loop, batching, KV cache)? If yes -> bench + perf unit.
- Could this change make debugging harder in prod (silenced errors, missing traces)? If yes -> require additional logs/traces.

Heuristic checklist (fast pass, ~5–10 min):
- [ ] PR description: one-paragraph summary + rationale + link to ticket.
- [ ] Tests: unit + integration (happy path) exist; if touching async or batching, add a flaky guard.
- [ ] Metrics: new metrics/alerts? (If behavioral change, add one-line metrics proposal).
- [ ] Docs: public surface or config changes noted in README or console docs.
- [ ] Backward compatibility: schema/checkpoint/kv layout mismatch? Add migration note.
- [ ] Import surface: no heavy transitive deps.

Refactor triggers (notes-to-self):
- When a file grows > 400 lines or has 3+ responsibilities, propose: extract 'request-serializer' or 'batch-controller'.
- If tests mock internals more than public API, create a test harness that exercises the runtime path (less mocking).
- Repeated if/else across files -> consider a small dispatch util or strategy object.

Small follow-ups I add as comments in PRs (examples):
- "Tiny: rename local var 'reqCtx' -> 'requestCtx' for readability (will follow up in separate PR)."
- "Perf note: suggest adding a microbenchmark in bench/kv-cache to quantify impact (ENG-8213)."
- "Observability: include request id in error branch for easier Sentry grouping."

Edge-case checklist for serving/runtime changes:
- Negative/zero sequence lengths handled?
- Backpressure: are we blocking tokio/worker threads on IO?
- KV cache eviction: verify TTL and fallback behavior when cache miss + concurrent fill.

Quick commands and test pointers (notes):
- Local perf run: ./tools/bench --profile kv --iters 200 --concurrency 8
- Run flaky integration: pytest tests/integration/test_batching.py -k flaky_local
- Start local stack: docker-compose -f local/dev-stack.yml up --build

Unresolved questions to ask author: (drop directly in review comment)
- "Why choose this quantization profile vs q4_0? Link to perf/quality tradeoffs."
- "Is the fallback model variant intended to be part of this rollout or temporary? Add rollout plan."
- "Does this rely on any implicit ordering of headers/metadata? If so, document in function docstring."

Follow-up actions (I usually create small tickets):
- Create small refactor ticket: extract topic parser from handler (label: low-risk, owner: me).
- Add bench + perf alert for new path (label: infra/bench).
- Add test harness that simulates concurrent cache fills (label: tests/flake).

Personal reminders / style preferences (for code review tone):
- Prefer suggestion comments (GitHub suggestion patch) for small renames instead of long comments.
- For larger design questions, ask for an ADR or a short design note in the PR.
- Keep language neutral: describe risk and propose a small mitigation or rollback strategy.

Random snippet I often paste in reviews:
"Small perf regression guard: add FEATURE_FLAG_ENABLE_NEW_PATH with default off and a quick smoke canary that flips on in staging for 1–2 hours. If we see a +X% CPU or +Y ms p50, roll back."

Last quick notes:
- I keep this doc intentionally terse so it stays usable in the editor.
- If a PR hits multiple items on the refactor triggers list, call for a short sync instead of long back-and-forth.
- When in doubt, ask for a demo of the change and a short trace (zipkin/span) showing the new path.

TODO (someday): convert these heuristics into a checklist template in GH PR templates and add a small lint that flags missing perf tests when code touches /runtime/ or /kv-cache/ paths.
